Gas Engineering is focused on ensuring the safe and reliable flow of natural gas to our customers. The Analyst will coordinate SAP tasks related to drawing custody and work order management, maintain and enhance reporting dashboards, and support cross-functional collaboration between engineering, drafting, construction, and records teams. Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

**WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING**  
  
Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. * Keep QuickBooks Online accurate and up to date.
* Stay close to our project team so you always know where things stand.
* Keep the office organized, stocked and running.

* A positive team with good energy. We work hard, keep it light, and look out for each other.
* A new office in Walnut Creek, right next to BART, with free parking.
* Monday to Friday, daytime hours, weekends off.
* Modern tools, so you're not fighting old systems.
* Real ownership of your work and a direct line to the founder.
* 401(k) with company match, paid holidays and paid sick leave.

* People describe you as steady, warm and trustworthy.

jobs.desc:
We are seeking an experienced Plumbing Estimator to develop accurate and competitive cost estimates for commercial and industrial plumbing and process piping projects. The ideal candidate has hands-on plumbing estimating experience, strong technical drawing interpretation skills, and a thorough understanding of construction costs, materials, labor, and installation methods.

This role requires the ability to independently evaluate project requirements, perform detailed quantity takeoffs, obtain supplier pricing, and prepare comprehensive bids that support profitable project execution.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Prepare detailed cost estimates, bids, and budgets for labor, materials, equipment, and installation costs on commercial and industrial plumbing projects.
* Review blueprints, MEP drawings, specifications, and bid documents to determine project scope and complete accurate quantity takeoffs.
* Identify scope gaps, potential cost overruns, and project risks before submitting bids.
* Request and evaluate quotations from suppliers, vendors, and subcontractors to develop accurate and competitive pricing.
* Coordinate with general contractors, engineers, suppliers, and trade partners to clarify project requirements and resolve estimating questions.
* Evaluate project specifications, system requirements, and installation methods to ensure estimates cover the full scope of work.
* Prepare pricing for change orders and maintain organized bid documentation, cost records, and historical estimating data.
* Review estimates for accuracy and completeness before final submission.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of experience in commercial or industrial plumbing estimating.
* Direct experience estimating plumbing systems, process piping, or related installations.
* Previous experience working for a plumbing, mechanical, or MEP contracting company.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, plumbing layouts, MEP drawings, and construction specifications

Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries - AI & cloud compute, electric-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. We have managed to produce the world's first single-crystal diamond wafers and are now on a mission to put a diamond behind every chip. We are the rare unicorn that has grown fast and profitably. We received $515m in funding and are executing a multi-$B expansion plan for one of the greenest forms of tech manufacturing: converting greenhouse gas into diamond wafers using zero-emission energy.

Diamond Foundry is looking for a Materials Process Engineer to help develop and scale processes for a proprietary advanced material used in our diamond manufacturing. You will work hands-on across the process: molding and extruding the material, characterizing its properties, and engineering its interfaces with diamond and glass substrates. It’s a rare early-career chance to take a novel material from lab experiments to high-volume production, working alongside laser, optical, and manufacturing engineers.

This role will be located in Fremont, CA, and will require this candidate to be on-site 5 days a week.

### **Responsibilities**

* Run moderate-temperature molding processes and help design and fabricate molds, tuning temperature, pressure, and surface finish to reduce defects
* Run extrusion trials and measure how temperature, pressure, and die design affect flow, surface quality, and dimensional consistency
* Characterize the material’s thermal, optical, and flow properties before and after processing, and track how they change over reuse cycles
* Clean and functionalize diamond and glass substrate surfaces (e.g., plasma treatment) and evaluate adhesion and interface quality
* Run designed experiments and turn the data into process improvements, documenting them in SOPs and following EHS practices for toxic materials

### **Requirements**

* BS or MS in Materials Science, Chemical Engine

jobs.title: Plumbing Estimator - Commercial & Industrial Plumbing
jobs.desc:
We’re seeking an experienced Plumbing Estimator to prepare accurate, competitive bids for commercial and industrial plumbing and process piping projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare estimates, bids, and budgets for labor, materials, equipment, and installation costs.

* Coordinate with general contractors, engineers, and trade partners to clarify project requirements.
* Update estimates for change orders and maintain organized bid records and historical cost data.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of commercial or industrial plumbing estimating experience.
* Direct experience estimating plumbing systems and/or process piping installations.
* Background with a plumbing, mechanical, or MEP contracting company.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, plumbing layouts, and construction specifications.
* Strong knowledge of construction labor costs, material pricing, and estimating methods.
* Proficiency with estimating software, digital takeoff tools, and Microsoft Office.

**Important:** Candidates must have direct commercial or industrial plumbing estimating experience. Residential-only estimators and general construction estimators without relevant plumbing experience will not qualify.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* Health insurance options.
* Retirement plan options.
* Paid time off.
* Additional company-sponsored benefits.
